description_en: Changes the status of a card from "rebind deactivated" to "rebind reactivated"
description_zh: 将状态为“换绑停用”的单卡操作为“换绑复用”
name: RebindResumeSingleCard

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can find the ICCID on the IoT card, or view it on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台 (https://dyiotnext.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a072d25p4pUg8)的卡管理页面查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform the operation on a sub-card. Set this parameter to the MSISDN of the sub-card.

This parameter is not required for a standard single-network card.
For a virtual network operator:
    - If you specify this parameter, the operation is performed on the specified sub-card.
    - If you do not specify this parameter, the operation is performed on all sub-cards
parameters.help_zh:
是否对子卡进行操作，填入子卡的MSISDN。

普通单网卡无需传入此参数。
虚拟运营商：
    - 如果传入该参数，则对指定的子卡进行操作。
    - 如果不传入该参数，则对所有子卡进行操作
parameters.name: opt_msisdns

Code.description_en:
The return code of the operation.

200: success.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）

Data.description_en:
The execution result.

true: The operation is successful.

false: The operation failed
Data.description_zh:
执行结果。

true：执行成功。

false：执行失败

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language that corresponds to the current location
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is the identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed

是否调用成功。
